detail.longDescription: Hi there. I used to work in international trade, and encountered many situations where people create a PDF from a system, send it to another party, and the other party parses the PDF to input into their system. As AI agents become first principles to deal with the documents, I believe the extra document creation and parsing step will become unnecessary. So I created a JSON viewer, where you can sign JSON and send it to other parties as a portable document. It can also display JSON data in a more document-like format. I’m wondering if such a format can be used as a replacement for some document communication today. I'd be so happy to hear your thoughts.
